sentences.text: Global App Market is a 2018 Marimekko stacked-bar chart in which x position identifies Region, column width encodes regional market totals, and segment height encodes platform Percentage; separate annotations report 2017-2022 CAGR. The color encoding maps Platform to chart colors: cyan represents iOS, lime green represents Google Play, and slate blue represents Third Party Android.

The 2018 regional market totals are $72B for Asia Pacific, $61B for Americas, $13B for EMEA, and $146B worldwide. Regional 2017-2022 CAGR values are 13.7%, 14.3%, 14.3%, and 13.9%, respectively; platform CAGR is 12.2% for iOS, 13.7% for Google Play, and 17.9% for Third Party Android.

iOS is the largest platform share in every region: 45% in Asia Pacific, 87% in Americas, 54% in EMEA, and 63% worldwide. Asia Pacific and Worldwide share the same three-platform partition, but their contribution profiles differ: 37%, 18%, and 45% versus 18%, 19%, and 63% for Third Party Android, Google Play, and iOS, respectively.

In 2018, iOS dominates the global app market, acco-unting for 63% of the total market. Over the 2017–2022 period, Third Party Android is projected to have the high-est CAGR among all platforms, reaching 17.9%.
